prompts.name: tier-4-wild
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a game character concept sheet for TIER 4 WILD GUARDS. Attached image is the approved STYLE reference: match its exceptionally simple low-poly geometry, broad flat faces, blocky chunky limbs, black dot eyes, matte solid colors and adorable proportions. Three rows and two columns, each row contains the SAME creature twice: left IDLE / right CHASE. Row 1 DIRE WOLF: gray-blue wolf, chunky head, pointed ears, bushy angular tail, simple pale muzzle. Row 2 GORILLA: warm charcoal gorilla, broad square head, huge simple forearms, short legs, beige muzzle, readable knuckle-walking silhouette. Row 3 RAPTOR: emerald green small dinosaur, huge blocky head, short arms, two strong legs, long thick balancing tail, cream belly; no feather detail. All are large companion guards but fit in a small game yard. Idle: cute black dot eyes, relaxed brows, closed tiny smiling mouth, calm planted pose. Chase: SAME proportions/colors/geometry, clearly threatening expression with glowing bright RED eyes, sharply lowered eyebrow shapes, open hinged jaw with a few LARGE triangular ivory teeth and dark mouth interior, forward leaning running/lunging pose. Gorilla also opens mouth with two simple fangs; wolf runs on four legs; raptor runs on two. Scary but playful stylized game enemy, no gore, no realistic horror, no blood. Chase faces must be unmistakably angry, not happy with recolored eyes. Make mouths easy to reproduce with a separate lower-jaw mesh; no intricate lips or wrinkles. Low polygon count across all characters, no fur texture, no realistic muscles, no tiny tessellated facets, no glossy toy shading. Clean ivory background, soft tiny ground shadows. Landscape 3:2 composition with enough panel space and no clipping. Bold readable top heading 'WILD GUARDS — TIER 4', column headings 'IDLE' and 'CHASE', small row labels 'DIRE WOLF', 'GORILLA', 'RAPTOR'. Exactly six creature depictions, one idle/chase pair per row, no other animals, no props or scenery. Full bodies including tails and ears.
